info.title: Information
info.description: BloodPressure is an application to record, monitor and analyze blood pressure readings. It allows you to enter daily measurements, view trends and KPIs, customize clinical thresholds, and manage data import/export in Excel or XML format. It also includes license management and an admin area for user control.
info.about.title: About me
info.about.p1: I am a software developer specialized in building web applications and backend services in the .NET ecosystem. I design scalable and maintainable architectures following Clean Architecture, SOLID principles and separation of concerns.
info.about.p2: I build high-performance and secure microservices APIs using C#, with particular attention to error handling, data validation, structured logging, resilience and performance optimization.
info.about.p3: I work with relational and non-relational databases, focusing on data modeling, indexing and optimized query writing. I design containerized systems with Docker, CI/CD pipeline integration and automated deployment processes.
info.about.p4: I integrate observability practices through centralized logging, metrics and application monitoring to ensure reliability and operational continuity.
info.about.p5: I manage projects end-to-end, from requirements analysis to architectural design, up to production release and post-deploy monitoring, taking technical ownership of the entire application lifecycle.
